info.title: Superstep public API
info.description:
Start workflow runs from other services and read their results, and talk to a published chat.

Authenticate with a **workflow token** (`wft_…`) in `X-Workflow-Token` or `Authorization: Bearer`. The workflow owner
creates tokens in the editor under **⋯ → API**; each token starts runs of one workflow only.

Every response is an envelope: `{"success": true, "data": …, "error": null}` or
`{"success": false, "data": null, "error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. `code` is the stable contract.

**Chat API v1** (`/api/public/v1/chat/{slug}`): the published chat page of a workflow. An anonymous visitor is identified
by a visitor token: send `X-Chat-Visitor: new` once, keep the `visitor_token` of the answer and send it back in
`X-Chat-Visitor`. Messages are sent over the WebSocket `/ws/public/v1/chat/{slug}`. Clients must ignore fields they do
not know: v1 only grows.

post.description:
Queue a run of the workflow's latest saved version with `input` as the initial state.

Each token may start `STUDIO_TRIGGER_RATE_LIMIT` runs per `STUDIO_TRIGGER_RATE_WINDOW` seconds; over the limit the
answer is `429 RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`.

get.description:
Status and result of a run started with this workflow's tokens. Polling is not rate limited.

Finished statuses: `ok`, `error`, `cancelled`, `timeout`, `waiting` (paused at a Human node), `expired`.

ChatRatingIn.title: ChatRatingIn
ChatRatingIn.description: A thumbs up or down on one finished answer (DEC-0070). `comment` is only kept with a thumbs down.

visitor_token.title: Visitor Token
visitor_token.description: Set once for a new anonymous visitor that sent `X-Chat-Visitor: new`: keep it and send it back in `X-Chat-Visitor`.

steps.title: Steps

child_run_id.title: Child Run Id
child_run_id.description: Set while an Agent node's workflow tool runs: the child run the run waits for.

RunWaiting.title: RunWaiting
RunWaiting.description: Set when status is `waiting`: the Human node the run is paused at, or the child run of a workflow tool it waits for.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `async` returns 202 at once. `sync` waits up to STUDIO_SYNC_WAIT_MAX seconds for the result, then falls back to 202 with `poll_url`.

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: Public http(s) URL that receives a signed POST when the run ends.
